module: Manages the vehicles and profiles (personas) of players in multi-seat: choice of suggested vehicles, automatic colors close to the player's color, "staged" state of the settings (vehicle, icon, driving preferences), spawning, replacing, gathering and deleting vehicles, vehicle selectors and summary (digest) data. It is the engine behind ui_multiseat_multiseatSettings and ui_multiseat_freeroam. It tracks the vehicles owned per persona (ownedByPersona) and survives a Lua reload via onSerialize/onDeserialized.
notes: Fallback vehicles (fallbackVehicles): covet, pessima, pickup, roamer, vivace. A suggestion is only valid if {model, config} are strings and the file /<config> exists.

Priority order of getSuggestedVehicles: mainLevel.getMultiseatSuggestedVehicles(playerCount) (at least one valid vehicle per player is needed), then the gamemode pool (gameplay_multiseat_gamemodeManager.getVehiclePool), then level.multiseat.suggestedVehicles from info.json, then the fallback vehicles.

Automatic color: among the model's paints, those whose main color is close to the player's color (squared RGB distance <= 0.04); the choice among the 3 closest is stable (hash of persona|model|config). Without automatic color: paint chosen in the selector, otherwise the factory paint with the closest hue, otherwise the default paint.
A player's driving preferences: gearbox ("arcade" or "realistic"), clutchAssist, throttleAssist, ignitionLevel (integer 0 to 3), characterFace.

Reason codes returned: player_unavailable, invalid_vehicle_selection, persona_update_failed, vehicle_replace_failed, vehicle_spawn_failed, no_players, player_limit_exceeded, vehicles_not_prepared, prepared_vehicle_missing.

Settings application in three steps: prepareStagedChanges (spawns the new vehicles), configuration commitCore, then finalizeStagedChanges (deletes surplus vehicles, assigns the players, applies the preferences).

Probable BUG: getAutomaticColorEnabled uses the "a == nil and b or c" idiom; when nothing is staged and the multiseatAutomaticColor setting is false, the expression returns nil instead of false (harmless effect since nil is treated as false).
UI event emitted: app:waiting (true/false) while replacing a vehicle from the quick selector; the replacement itself is executed in the onUiWaitingState hook.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: core_locales, core_playerPersonas, core_vehicle_configTarget, ui_gridSelectorRouteLifecycleCallbacks, ui_vehicleSelector_general.

getSuggestedVehiclesForLevel.desc: Picks one vehicle per player from the level's multiseat.suggestedVehicles pool (info.json), otherwise from the fallback vehicles; the pool is shuffled then looped over.

returns.desc: List of {model, config}, one entry per player.

getSuggestedVehicles.desc: Returns one suggested vehicle per player by trying, in order: the level function mainLevel.getMultiseatSuggestedVehicles, the gamemode pool, then getSuggestedVehiclesForLevel.

getAutomaticColorEnabled.desc: Returns whether automatic color is enabled (staged value if it exists, otherwise the multiseatAutomaticColor setting). See the note on the nil case.

setCustomSplitPlayers.desc: Sets the list of players displayed in split screen (copy) and passes it to render_splitScreen.setCustomPlayers.

clearCustomSplitPlayers.desc: Clears the custom list and goes back to the registered players (render_splitScreen.clearCustomPlayers if available).

getStagedChanges.desc: Compares the active state to the staged state and returns {dirty, requiresRestart, rosterChanged, vehicleChanged, colorChanged, iconChanged, preferencesChanged}. A change of players or of model/config requires a restart; a simple color is repainted on the vehicle in place.

hasUserChanges.desc: Returns whether the staged state differs from the initial state taken when the screen was opened.

returns.desc: true if the user modified something.

getStagedPlayers.desc: Sorted list of the indices of players registered in the staged state.

getPersonaSelectorData.desc: Data of the "personas" component of the settings screen: the multiseatConfiguration preview with playerLimit recomputed for the level (playerLimits.getCurrentLevelState).

getSettingsData.desc: Data of the "vehicles" component: for each staged player, personaId, label, icon and selectable icons, color, connection state, device label, vehicle {model, config, label, paints} and preferences; plus characterFaceOptions.

getDigestData.desc: Data of the vehicle summary for each registered player (label, device, vehicle, actions "changeVehicle" and "configureVehicle" with their buttonId). First assigns default vehicles to personas that have none.

executeDigestAction.desc: Executes the summary button identified by buttonId.

returns.desc: false if buttonId is nil, otherwise the button's result.

configurePlayerVehicle.desc: Opens a player's vehicle parts configuration screen: starts core_vehicle_configTarget, switches to solo view (render_splitScreen.beginSoloView) then navigates to "pause.vehicle.configurationcombined". Cancels everything if a step fails.

vehicle.desc: Vehicle object; must be the one owned by the player.

returns.desc: true if the screen is open.

stagePlayerOptIn.desc: Stages a player's exit (only optedIn = false is accepted; true returns false).

returns.desc: true if the player was removed.

cycleDevicePlayer.desc: Delegates to multiseatConfiguration.cycleDevicePlayer then resynchronizes the staged state.

toggleDevicePlayer.desc: Delegates to multiseatConfiguration.toggleDevicePlayer then resynchronizes the staged state.

moveDevicePlayer.desc: Delegates to multiseatConfiguration.moveDevicePlayer then resynchronizes the staged state.

setDevicePlayer.desc: Delegates to multiseatConfiguration.setDevicePlayer then resynchronizes the staged state.

personaNumber.desc: Persona number, nil or 0 to unassign.

removeDevice.desc: Delegates to multiseatConfiguration.removeDevice (disconnected device) then resynchronizes.

leaveDeviceGroup.desc: Removes a player via multiseatConfiguration.leavePlayer then resynchronizes.

stagePlayerVehiclePreferences.desc: Stages a player's driving preferences after validation (gearbox arcade/realistic, ignitionLevel integer 0 to 3, valid characterFace).

returns.desc: false if the player is absent or a value is invalid.

stagePlayerIcon.desc: Stages a player's icon; refused if it is not a persona icon, if it is unchanged or already taken by another player.

stageAutomaticColorForAllPlayers.desc: Stages the automatic color mode for all players and recomputes the paint of their staged vehicle.

returns.desc: true if at least one vehicle changed.

getSharedVehicleOptions.desc: Options of the "same vehicle for everyone" field: distinct vehicles already staged (value = player index), then up to 8 recent vehicles (value "recent:model/config") after a separator. Returns nil if fewer than 2 players are staged.

returns.desc: Currently shared value, nil if the vehicles differ.

stageSameVehicleForAllPlayers.desc: Stages the same vehicle for all players, from "recent:model/config" or from the index of a player whose vehicle is copied.

returns.desc: true if at least one vehicle changed.

getGatherVehicleOptions.desc: Options of the "gather vehicles" field: a player as gathering point, then the level's spawn points (value "spawnPoint:objectName"). Returns nil if fewer than 2 vehicles are owned.

gatherVehicles.desc: Gathers the owned vehicles: next to a player's vehicle (index) or at a spawn point ("spawnPoint:objectName"), lining them up one after another on the right side.

returns.desc: true if at least one vehicle was moved.

reseatAllPlayers.desc: Puts each player back in their owned vehicle if they are no longer in it.

returns.desc: true if at least one player was reseated.

openVehicleSelectorForPlayer.desc: Opens the vehicle selector for a staged player (route pause.multiseatSettings.vehicleSelector). On selection, the vehicle is staged and it returns to the settings screen.

returns.desc: false if the player is not registered.

openVehicleSelectorForAllPlayers.desc: Opens the vehicle selector and applies the choice to all staged players (at least 2 required).

returns.desc: false if there are fewer than 2 players.

onVehicleSelectorLeave.desc: Called by multiseatSettings when leaving the selector route; cancels the pending selection if this route is really being left.

replacePlayerVehicle.desc: Live-replaces the vehicle of an active multiseat player (updates the persona, replaces or spawns the vehicle, assigns the player and resets the camera). Restores the old persona on failure.

additionalData.desc: Selector data; paint, paint2, paint3 give the chosen paints.

openQuickVehicleSelectorForPlayer.desc: Opens the quick selector (route pause.multiseatVehicleSelector) from the pause menu; on selection, returns to "pause" then replaces the vehicle after the onUiWaitingState event.

returns.desc: false if multiseat is inactive or the player is absent.

onQuickVehicleSelectorEnter.desc: Entry callback of the quick selector route; delegates to ui_gridSelectorRouteLifecycleCallbacks.onRouteEnter.

onQuickVehicleSelectorMount.desc: Mount callback of the quick selector route; delegates to ui_gridSelectorRouteLifecycleCallbacks.onRouteMount.

onQuickVehicleSelectorLeave.desc: Exit callback of the quick selector route; delegates to gridSelector then forgets the pending player if the route is left.

adoptFreeroamVehicle.desc: Makes a player adopt an existing vehicle: records {model, config} in its persona and tracks the vehicle as owned.

returns.desc: false if the player or the vehicle is invalid.

setPlayerVehicleSelection.desc: Records {model, config} as the vehicle of a player's persona (without spawning a vehicle).

returns.desc: true if the persona was updated.

reconcileFreeroamVehicles.desc: Brings the owned vehicles in line with the registered players: deletes those of players who left, replaces vehicles that differ from the selection (except options.preserveOwned) and spawns missing ones behind an existing vehicle on the road (core_multiSpawn "roadBehind"), otherwise next to it. Then assigns each player and resynchronizes the split screen.

options.desc: preserveOwned = true keeps the existing vehicles as they are.

prepareStagedChanges.desc: First application step: checks players and limit, writes the staged data into the personas and spawns new or different vehicles (the others are repainted). The created vehicles are kept in a plan until finalizeStagedChanges or cancelPreparedChanges.

finalizeStagedChanges.desc: Last step: deletes vehicles that became unnecessary, records the session selections, assigns each player to their vehicle, applies the preferences and deletes pre-existing unowned vehicles (if multiseat is starting). Resets the staged state.

changes.desc: Result of getStagedChanges, returned as is.

applyStagedChanges.desc: Chains prepareStagedChanges, multiseatConfiguration.commitCore, finalizeStagedChanges and completeCommit, with rollback on failure.

cancelPreparedChanges.desc: Deletes the vehicles created by prepareStagedChanges and forgets the plan.

discardStagedChanges.desc: Abandons the staged state and forces its rebuild on the next access.

resetSettingsSnapshots.desc: Resets the settings screen snapshots (called when it closes).

getVehicleForPlayer.desc: Returns a copy of the vehicle {model, config, ...} of a player's persona.

returns.desc: Vehicle, nil if the player is absent.

spawnAll.desc: Deletes all owned vehicles then spawns each plan player's vehicle at its position (parking spot or pos/rot), assigns the player and tracks the vehicle.

spawnPlan.desc: List of {player, parkingSpot} or {player, pos, rot}.

reconcileSpawnPlan.desc: Matches the vehicles to a spawn plan by reusing or replacing them if needed, and deletes the others unless options.removeMissing == false. options.customPlayers sets the list of split screen players.

removeAll.desc: Deletes all owned vehicles (players leave them first).

clearSession.desc: Clears all session data (selections, active and staged states, reload preferences).

abandonPlayerVehicle.desc: Stops tracking a player's vehicle without deleting it, so that it survives removeAll when leaving multiseat.

getOwnedVehicles.desc: List, sorted by player, of owned vehicle entries still present in the scene.

setFrozen.desc: Freezes or unfreezes vehicles via core_vehicleBridge (action setFreeze).

spawned.desc: Vehicle entries; all owned vehicles if nil.

repaintOwnedVehicles.desc: Repaints the owned vehicles with their persona's paints (live color update).

areVehiclesReady.desc: Returns whether all the given (or owned) vehicles exist and are ready (veh:isReady).

isSynchronizing.desc: Returns whether a snapshot is being built, changes are being applied or a preparation is pending.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before a Lua reload; if multiseat is active, returns the owned vehicles, the session selections and the preferences, and prevents the vehicles from being deleted on unload.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after a Lua reload; relinks the serialized vehicles to the players and schedules a reconciliation.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame; after a reload, reconciles the vehicles (preserveOwned), restores the preferences and unfreezes the vehicles as soon as participants are present.

onUiWaitingState.desc: Hook called when the UI shows the waiting state; executes the vehicle replacement deferred by the quick selector.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the level; clears all state (the vehicles leave with the level).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called when the extension is unloaded; deletes the owned vehicles unless a Lua reload is in progress (preserveVehiclesOnUnload), then clears the state.
